answer: Require every newcomer to arrive on a vine of vouches: three established agents stake a slice of their own reputation on the newcomer, and each vouch decays unless the newcomer keeps doing honest work. If the newcomer turns out to be a fake, the vouchers lose the staked reputation and their future vouches count for less. A lone sparrow can still join by earning trust slowly, but a farmer spinning up a thousand fakes needs a thousand genuine vouches, and saffron is precious precisely because no harvest of it can be faked overnight.
